title: 第11章 走上双修大道第12章 赚取灵石
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
想了想之后，顾平又把目光放在了这九幽峰的土地上。
片刻后，他开始用青石敲打，花费了半天时间，敲打出来了出一个石犁。
他像牛一样，迈着沉重的步伐在前边拉犁，九幽峰的大片荒地开始被松土垦荒。
灵田规模还可以扩大。
只要灵米能够及时产出，他的修行资粮就不会那么依赖血髓灵芝。
半天时间，顾平亲自拉犁，耕出了三亩地。
没有血髓灵芝的帮助之后，果然，他的炼体进境还是慢了下来。
“这鸡崽子赶紧长大才对啊。”
他从密林里割了十几捆，大树的叶子，这些树并不怎么名贵，但长久生长在灵气充沛又紧锁的九幽峰，树叶和枝干也带着灵力，割了喂鸡最好不过。
把鸡喂饱了之后。
顾平就出门。
外门弟子是无法进入藏经阁的，所以像是布雨术这种灵植师擅长的玩意必须要去买才行。
璃月宗又没有一座山峰是教授灵植的。
顾平自己也是摸着石头过河。
一个没忍住，他又绕到了珍宝阁。
管事一看是顾平，立即拱起了手，“恭喜道友，晋升外门弟子。”
顾平摆了摆手，气色比上次来的时候好太多了。
“想来顾道友应该是转运了，最近几天不见，这变化真是让人心惊啊。”
“就是那些真传弟子的修行速度也不过如此啊。”
管事一顿马屁拍的顾平心痒难耐。

不断地摆手，“哎，管事的不要硬夸嘛，你不夸我，我也是要在你这里买东西的。”
咬了咬牙，顾平又从珍宝阁买了100枚血髓灵芝，花费3000枚下灵。
用100块买到了《灵植布雨术》。
他身上就只剩下100下灵了。
只够买1袋灵米种子。
这可不行。
他没办法，只能验明身份又取了5000下灵出来，“再买40袋灵米种子。”
“啊？”
这管事和道童都惊了。
这得是四十亩地才能种的下这么多种子。
管事的不愿意坑顾平，也是急忙把这种灵米的习性告知顾平“
“顾道友，这种灵米需要谨慎照顾的，需要不停布雨催肥，补充灵田地力。”
“催肥的法术我可以100灵石便宜卖给你，但是给灵田补充地力，可就难得多了，必须要修士将灵植或者妖兽粉碎变成养料后撒在地里补充地力……恕我直言，几十亩地需要你做的工作量可是不小啊。”
顾平也是犹豫。
content_en:
After thinking about it, Gu Ping set his sights on the land of Jiuyou Peak again.
After a while, he started pounding with bluestone, and it took him half a day to hammer out a stone plow.
Like an ox, he took heavy steps to pull the plow in front, and the large wasteland of Jiuyou Peak began to be loosened and reclaimed.
The scale of the spiritual field can be expanded.
As long as the spiritual rice can be produced in time, his cultivation qualifications will not be so dependent on the blood marrow Ganoderma lucidum.
In half a day, Gu Ping pulled the plow himself and plowed three acres of land.
Without the help of the Blood Marrow Ganoderma, as expected, his body refining progress slowed down.
"This little chicken should grow up quickly."
He cut more than a dozen bundles of leaves from big trees in the dense forest. These trees are not very valuable, but they have grown in Jiuyou Peak, where spiritual energy is abundant and tightly locked. The leaves and branches also carry spiritual power. It is best to cut them and feed them to chickens.
After feeding the chicken.
Gu Ping went out.
Outer disciples cannot enter the Sutra Pavilion, so things like rain-making techniques that spiritual planters are good at must be purchased.
There is no mountain peak in Liyue Sect that teaches Lingzhi.
Gu Ping himself also crossed the river by feeling the stones.
Unable to hold it back, he went around to the Treasure Pavilion again.
When the steward saw it was Gu Ping, he immediately raised his hands and said, "Congratulations, fellow Taoist, for being promoted to an outer disciple."
Gu Ping waved his hand, looking much better than when he came last time.
"I think Taoist friend Gu has changed his fortune. He hasn't been seen in the past few days. This change is really shocking."
"Even those true disciples can only practice at this speed."
Gu Ping felt itchy after being flattered by the manager.
He kept waving his hands and said, "Hey, the boss, don't insist on praising me. If you don't praise me, I will buy something from you."
Gritting his teeth, Gu Ping bought another 100 blood marrow Ganoderma lucidum from Zhenbao Pavilion, spending 3,000 lower spirits.
I bought "Spirit Planting Rain Technique" for 100 yuan.
He only has 100 spirits left on him.
Only enough to buy 1 bag of Lingmi seeds.
This is not okay.
He had no choice but to verify his identity and take out another 5,000 spirits, "Buy another 40 bags of spirit rice seeds."
"Huh?"
The steward and the Taoist boy were both shocked.
It would take 40 acres of land to plant so many seeds.
The manager didn’t want to trick Gu Ping, so he hurriedly told Gu Ping about this spiritual rice habit.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, this kind of spiritual rice needs careful care. It needs constant rain to fertilize and replenish the fertility of the spiritual field. "
"I can sell you the fattening spell for 100 spirit stones at a low price, but it is much more difficult to replenish the soil of the spiritual field. The monks must crush the spiritual plants or monsters into nutrients and scatter them in the ground to replenish the soil... With all due respect, the amount of work you need to do on dozens of acres of land is quite a lot. "
Gu Ping also hesitated.
